citations.assessment: The Bavli explicitly names Ila son of Rav Shmuel bar Marta and his report from Rav on the first verse of the Shema.
The exact named dossier is the intended cross-reference. A separate Kessef Mishneh reading supplies Yitzchak within Ila’s patronym without settling the genealogy.

evidence.reference: Kessef Mishneh on Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2:3:2
